prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of the element Carbon (탄소) itself — the sovereign of the Carbon Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Carbon (C) to carry in her design and the scene: two faces of one element: black soot and clear diamond; hexagonal lattices (graphite, graphene) as patterns, pencil-graphite grey, carbon-fibre weave; it bonds with everything and is the frame of all life. Palette: charcoal black, graphite grey, diamond white, a single living green.
AGE: late twenties — a settled, mature adult face with defined cheekbones; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
SILHOUETTE: slender build; long straight hair with long bangs falling over one eye; soot-black hair with a graphite sheen.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — an elegant, refined presence; warm beige skin; long face; moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes — deep-set eyes, level outer eye corners; thick straight brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; leaf-green eyes; bold red lipstick.
WORLD — FANTASY: a charcoal-burner's forest and a diamond mine: hexagonal crystal caves, smoking charcoal kilns, a world tree with lattice-patterned bark. COSTUME (fantasy): a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns. No corset, no bustle, no Victorian tailoring, no modern material, no machinery. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, anime facial design that keeps each character's own facial structure, eye proportions and skin tone instead of one house face, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
EXPRESSION: relaxed brow, softly open eyes, lips closed and unstrained, no smile.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (C) and atomic number (6) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
